browserSearchPath: CLMS Land Cover/Land Use, Dynamic Land Cover
collectionDescription: Land cover is provided yearly at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~10 m, derived from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data. A discrete map of 11 land cover classes is accompanied by a probability layer for each class.

layers.longDescription: Land Cover Map (LCM) giving the dominant land cover class of each pixel among 11 classes defined with the FAO Land Cover Classification System (LCCS): tree cover, shrubland, grassland, cropland, herbaceous wetland, mangroves, moss and lichen, bare/sparse vegetation, built-up, permanent water bodies, and snow and ice. Pixels without Sentinel-1 or Sentinel-2 observations of sufficient quality are labelled as unclassifiable.

Continuous rendering of the Land Cover Map (LCM) in which the colour of each pixel is the mix of the 11 class colours, weighted by the class probabilities of the PROB file. Pure class colours indicate strong support for a single class, while blended colours reveal pixels where several classes receive similar support.

Probability of the tree cover class (code 10), stored as band 1 of the PROB file, between 0 and 1, expressing the relative support for this class in the final annual classification. It combines model certainty, spatial cover fraction and temporal persistence, and should not be interpreted as a direct measure of any of them.
